items.html: And behold, the pregnancy and nursing and mochin that are done after the sawing, at the return face to face, at the blessing of the Patriarchs, at the blessing of "Magen Avraham" — it is the Hesed of the name MaH, which now enters ZA. Understand this: for they are new mochin of the aspect of face to face. (But from elsewhere it appears that the externality has inner and surrounding lights in it, and likewise the inner aspect has an inner light and a surrounding light. And the name MaH is the Hasadim; and this is the secret of "Hesed came and separated them into wings.")
